title: Fractal anti-tori
summary: Let $Γ$ be a group acting properly and cocompactly on the product of two trees $T_1$ and $T_2$. An anti-torus is a non-periodic flat plane in $T_1 \times T_2$ that is the convex hull of two secant periodic lines. That notion was introduced by Dani Wise as a tool to show that $Γ$ is irreducible. We establish a new criterion ensuring the existence of anti-tori, and use it to prove that if $Γ$ is an $S$-arithmetic lattice in a product of simple algebraic groups of rank one, then $T_1\times T_2$ contains anti-tori.
